final_release_installer.window: The window's contents were not read. The maintainer was using the Mac, so the app could not be brought to the front; the accessibility interface exposed only the window controls, and a capture of the window showed it unpainted. The same capture of a build of the same features from commit 6fdb3aad, whose interface was walked in front on the same day while recording the binary-only demo, gave a byte-identical unpainted image, so the capture shows the background launch, not a rendering failure; it does not show that the installer's pages render.
